usdRate.sourceName: Federal Reserve H.10 (FRED DEXSFUS), South African rand per US dollar, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: The Namibia dollar is pegged one to one to the South African rand; R16.7055 per dollar on 30 October 2026 (World Bank 2025 average 17.89). The Bank of Namibia daily rates page could not be read.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Namibia Statistics Agency CPI, September 2026, via Trading Economics
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: annual inflation 5.4% in September 2026 (5.0% in August), the highest in over two years, driven by transport; the NSA site shows 5.4% as its latest rate but its bulletin could not be read.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Namibia inflation projections (4.2% for 2026, 4.0% for 2027); NSA CPI averaged about 4.7% a year over 2021-2025
inflation_projection.note: The Namibia dollar is pegged to the rand and inflation averaged about 4.7% over 2021-2025, while the Bank of Namibia projects 4.2% for 2026 and 4.0% for 2027 (revised up in October 2026), so 4.5% is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Namibia Monetary Policy Committee, October 2026 decision, via Trading Economics
policy_rate.note: Repo rate raised 25 basis points to 7.00% at the October 2026 meeting (6.75% since June 2026; 6.75% also shown for Q1 2026 in the Bank of Namibia Quarterly Bulletin June 2026). Secondary source; the October statement itself was not read.

savings_account_rate.note: The Bank of Namibia publishes only the weighted average deposit rate (4.19% in March 2026); no official savings-account rate was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No official 3-month fixed deposit rate was found; the Bank of Namibia publishes only the weighted average deposit rate (4.19% in March 2026).

fdr_1y_rate.note: No official 1-year fixed deposit rate could be read; an aggregator citing the Bank of Namibia lists about 4.15% for household 1-year term deposits in May 2026 but its page could not be loaded.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found in Bank of Namibia statistics.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table II.9 selected interest rates (average deposit rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average deposit rate of banks 4.19% at the end of March 2026 (4.16% in December 2025); later monthly figures were not found.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; government bonds and treasury bills are sold by Bank of Namibia auction.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Treasury bills auction results, 3 September 2026 (91-day bill maturing 4 December 2026)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average yield 7.163% on the 91-day bill; the 364-day bill averaged 7.649% at the same auction. Later results were not found.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table III.2(a) internal registered stock auctions (GC32, maturing 15 April 2032)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Weighted yield to maturity 9.46% at a March 2026 auction of the 9.00% GC32 (about 6 years to maturity); later bond auction results were not found.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table III.2(a) internal registered stock auctions (GC35, maturing 15 July 2035)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Weighted yield to maturity 10.22% at the second March 2026 auction of the 9.50% GC35 (about 9.3 years); the bulletin's average 10-year government bond yield was 10.08% in the first quarter of 2026. Later bond auction results were not found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Namibia, individual taxes on personal income (withholding taxes)
tax_bank_interest.note: 10% withholding tax on gross interest from a Namibian bank or unit trust paid to anyone other than a Namibian company; it is a final tax.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Namibia, individual income determination (interest income)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: There is no savings certificate, but interest on stock or securities issued by the government, including treasury bills, is exempt for natural persons.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Government Gazette No. 8842, GN 13 of 2026: Regulations relating to maximum coverage limits for guaranteed deposits (Deposit Guarantee Act, 2018)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Maximum coverage N$50,000 per depositor per member institution, up from N$25,000 (GN 24 of 2020, repealed).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap specific to credit cards or official typical credit card rate was found; the prime lending rate was 10.50% after the October 2026 repo increase.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table 3.3 NSX summary statistics
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for the local market, with returns near the tax-free treasury bill yield less a little.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table 3.3 NSX summary statistics; treasury bill auction results
equity_return_base.note: Base case: the NSX Local Index rose from about 511 (March 2022) to 819 (March 2026) but had a flat decade before that and the market is small and dominated by dual-listed South African shares, so equities are put about 3 points above the tax-free 1-year bill yield (7.6%), within the 4-point cap.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table 3.3 NSX summary statistics
equity_return_high.note: High case: a strong decade for local and dual-listed shares or a global index fund in Namibia dollar terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Federal Reserve H.10 rand per US dollar (Namibia dollar at par)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a small depreciation of the rand-pegged Namibia dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Federal Reserve H.10 rand per US dollar; World Bank official exchange rate history
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus about 3% a year of rand (and Namibia dollar) depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Federal Reserve H.10 rand per US dollar
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and a weaker rand.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table II.9 (average deposit rate 4.19%)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank deposits at about 4% less the 10% final withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Treasury bills auction results, 3 September 2026; PwC Tax Summaries (government interest exempt for individuals)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of fixed deposits (about 3.8% after tax) and tax-free treasury bills (7.2-7.6%).

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Treasury bills auction results, 3 September 2026
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 12-month treasury bills (7.65%) or short government bonds, tax-free for individuals.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: NAMFISA (the insurance regulator) publishes no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but no published premium rates per 1,000 Namibia dollars of cover by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Namibia was found from an official or international source.

health_premium_table.note: Private health cover is provided by medical aid funds, but no published contribution rates by age per 100,000 Namibia dollars of cover were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Namibia
oop_health_share.note: 7.5% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table I.16(a) national CPI by group (health)
goal_inflation_health.note: The health price index rose about 3.9% a year from 2020 to March 2026 and 5.3% in the year to September 2026, but private medical costs rise faster than the subsidised public part of the index, so 1.5 points above the 4.5% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table I.16(a) national CPI by group (education)
goal_inflation_education.note: The education price index rose about 3.1% a year from 2020 to March 2026 (fees reset each January); private school fees are assumed to rise slightly faster than the 4.5% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Namibia
life_expectancy.note: 67.5 years in 2024 (men 63.5, women 71.5); UN WPP 2024 gives 67.8 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person aged 65+ = 100 / old-age dependency ratio: ratio 6.37 in 2025 (World Bank) gives 15.7; 8.3 in 2040 (populationpyramid.net/namibia/2040/) gives 12.05; 16.1 in 2065 (populationpyramid.net/namibia/2065/) gives 6.21.

retirement_age_default.note: Namibia has no statutory retirement or pension age for private-sector workers: the Labour Act sets none and employers choose (often 60 or 65), per The Namibian, 28 July 2025; there is no public contributory pension.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: The Namibian, 'Labour Act silent on retirement age' (Public Service Act 1995)
retirement_age_government.note: Public servants retire at 60 under the Public Service Act 1995; early retirement from 55 with approval. Secondary source (the Act on NamibLII could not be loaded); older than 2025 rule still current.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026, table II.9 (average deposit rate)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: bank deposits after the 10% withholding tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Treasury bills auction results, 3 September 2026; PwC Tax Summaries
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of fixed deposits and tax-free treasury bills, below the 1-year bill yield of 7.65% (tax-free for individuals).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Treasury bills auction results, 3 September 2026
retirement_return_high.note: High case: most of the money in treasury bills and short government bonds, tax-free for individuals.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a cautious mix earning a little above after-tax deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026; equity base 10%; gold base 7%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of government bonds (9-10%), equity (local and global) unit trusts and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Namibia, Quarterly Bulletin June 2026; equity high 13%

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: New Era, 'Old-age pension breathes life into Gibeon' (2026/27 Budget)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The universal old-age grant was raised by N$100 to N$1,700 a month in the 2026/27 financial year (from April 2026), per New Era, 10 April 2026 (the same article also repeats the earlier N$1,600 level, which applied from April 2024).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: New Era, 'Old-age pension breathes life into Gibeon'; Ministry of Gender Equality old age grant page
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Paid to citizens and permanent residents aged 60 and older living in Namibia, without a means test (non-contributory); the ministry page could not be loaded (certificate error).

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Labour Act 11 of 2007, section 35 (severance pay), Legal Assistance Centre annotated statute
gratuity_rule.note: At least one week's remuneration per year of continuous service after 12 months, paid on dismissal (not for misconduct or poor performance), death, or resignation or retirement at 65; one week = 7/30.33 of a month. Law in force since 2008 (older than 2025, still current).

public_pension_scheme.note: Namibia has no public contributory old-age pension: the National Pension Fund planned under the Social Security Act has still not been implemented (The Brief and New Era, 2026; ILO actuarial review call); the Social Security Commission covers maternity, sick leave and death benefits only, and civil servants have their own fund (GIPF).

fdr_3m.note: Banks offer fixed and notice deposits; the Bank of Namibia publishes only an overall average deposit rate.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: 91, 182, 273 and 364-day bills auctioned by the Bank of Namibia for the government; interest is tax-free for individuals.

tbond_5y.note: Fixed-rate GC bonds auctioned by the Bank of Namibia and listed on the Namibian Stock Exchange.

tbond_10y.note: Lines maturing 2035, 2037, 2040 and later are on issue (GC35, GC37, GC40).

equity_fund.note: Supervised by NAMFISA; interest earned in unit trusts carries the 10% withholding tax.

gold.note: Gold is mostly bought as jewellery or imported bullion coins.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Old Age Grant (Ministry of Gender Equality)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health and Social Services (public health facilities)
